name: Telluric-Cirque
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by dead riverbeds and dry ocean basins and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
